release.title: Truthful Enrollment, Assistance Choice, Public Data Minimization, Professional Roles, and Portal Reconciliation
release.artifactSha256Location: Smarter_Justice_v1.7.10_Exact_Artifact_Test_Record.json (external companion generated after final ZIP testing)

deployment.statement: Code completion and exact-artifact testing do not change production status.

changes.problem: Public pages implied applications were open while the paid pilot was paused.
changes.implementation: Safe public status and separation of account/profile preparation from paid application/payment.
changes.preserved: Account creation and closed pilot/payment gates.

changes.problem: Rules help was described as AI-guided, saved work lacked affirmative AI choice, and provider details appeared publicly.
changes.implementation: Rules-only default, affirmative AI choice, binding preference, provider-neutral public responses, protected diagnostics.
changes.preserved: Rules organization and fail-closed sensitive AI.

changes.problem: Public health and AI status exposed internal details.
changes.implementation: Public health allowlist and protected AI diagnostics.
Shared roles in signup, accounts, profiles, edit, and display.
changes.preserved: Separate credential, payment, ranking, routing, engagement, and outcome states.

changes.problem: Public correction/removal paths were not visible enough.
changes.implementation: Prefilled correction, duplicate, suppression, and removal links.

changes.problem: Central portal records drifted from newer owner records.
changes.implementation: Reconciled versions and private boundaries without overriding dedicated truth.
changes.preserved: Separate brands, repositories, versions, deployments, and artifacts.

tests.path: fresh extraction, clean install/audit, npm test, syntax/JSON, ZIP safety, source equality, local health and boundaries
